title: Relative evaluation biduality respects distinguished triangles
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site small in the module universe, with a sheaf of commutative rings, and use its unbounded derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix any $K\in D(\mathcal O)$, and put $D_K(M)=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(M,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then $D_K$ is contravariantly triangulated. The transpose of evaluation after Koszul symmetry defines a natural transformation $\eta_M:M\to D_K^2M$. It commutes with the signed shift comparisons and takes every distinguished triangle to a morphism to its $D_K^2$ triangle, including the square on the connecting map. Thus objects for which $\eta_M$ is an isomorphism form a triangulated subcategory. The assertions hold for arbitrary $K$, and assert neither preservation of bounded constructibility nor invertibility of $\eta_M$ on arbitrary objects.

source.place: Tags 08JC (lemma-RHom-triangulated) and 0A97 (lemma-internal-hom-evaluate), with the signed evaluation construction of relative double duals
